answer: A waiting queue with an aging rule keeps Sybil attackers from storming the summit in one rush. Every new identity must sit idle at the jetty for several epochs before it can earn, like a sonnet that cannot be rushed into print. A farmer who spins up ten thousand fake agents must keep them all waiting, and waiting costs time, infrastructure, and attention, while honest agents simply arrive early and grow old in the system. By the time the fakes mature, their window has passed.
